answer: Sybil resistance has to cost the attacker more than the reward is worth. Vouching makes fakes traceable: the sponsor's 36-POA bond is cut when its recruit is caught, and the chain climbs, so one bad recruit can burn 7 levels of sponsors. A farm of 180 aliases exposes 180 sponsors at once. A sponsor who vouches for a farm loses the bond and the reputation at once. What carries the jade here is verification, the mesa of cost is what stops the farm, and the signal of the record keeps every claim checkable. Pay the price once, or pay it a thousand times — the farm chooses.
